summary: Second-pass regression + gap testing for TRU SYDS LLC single-page app. Backend pytest 6/6 PASS (contact CRUD+persistence, newsletter idempotency, ticket_hotc checkout (amount=6000, session_id, pending), donate_50 checkout, payment status, invalid lookup 500). Frontend gap-tests PASS: (a) MOBILE 390x844 — hero-3d-canvas present, headline 'Empowering Voices...' rendered white on dark scrim, computed color rgb(245,242,235), bbox height 103px — legible over dimmed cross (visual overlap of cross behind text remains but text is readable, matching intent of the mobile scrim fix). (b) All 4 Adinkra symbols render non-empty inline SVG (adinkrahene:120, dwennimmen:992, gyenyame:1199, oheneaniwa:491 chars), and clicking each updates the detail panel with correct name. (c) All 6 navbar data-testids (nav-about/work/adinkra/event/involved/contact) present; nav-contact click smooth-scrolls to Contact section. (d) Mobile menu open/close via menu-open-btn/menu-close-btn works. (e) Reveal animation headings appear after gradual scroll (About + Adinkra headings render into DOM; Adinkra heading is split across two RevealLine spans). (f) Contact section shows address '1196 Deansway Dr, Pataskala' and phone '703-475-5322'.

issues: Headline text remains legible (white on dark scrim), but the gold cross still sits behind the words 'Celebrating Culture'. Contrast is acceptable due to the scrim + white text; however the cross could be shifted further right/down or dimmed more if a cleaner separation is desired. NOT a blocking bug.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/payments/checkout returns 500 on missing Stripe price (per request spec) — semantically should be 400/404 but preserved to match the review contract.

Adinkra heading is split into two RevealLine children joined by a newline — automated substring searches for the full 'ancient language of leadership' phrase fail; consider a single wrapper data-testid='adinkra-heading' if easier E2E assertions are wanted.
Contact thank-you state has no dedicated data-testid (only send-another-btn) — adding data-testid='contact-thankyou' would improve E2E clarity.
test_credentials: None required. Stripe test mode; redirect to checkout.stripe.com verified (real card not exercised, per spec).
seed_data_creation: Stripe catalog pre-seeded (ticket_hotc, donate_25/50/100/250 all resolvable — verified by successful 200 checkout responses and amount=6000 for 2x ticket_hotc).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py as regression suite. Frontend URL from /app/frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All acceptance criteria from the review_request are met. If touching Hero3D again, verify the mobile scrim + cross opacity/position on 390x844 viewport — text must stay readable.
